benchmark: Heurion Deep Review — Full Architectural Component Ablation, 2×2 Orthogonal Evolution Disentanglement (Selective Stage-4 Routing vs. Unfiltered Global Stuffing), and 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation Benchmark (19 PMC Papers, 38 Manuscripts, 57 Injected Errors)

scoring_parity_verification.note: All regimes below are executed live on the identical current codebase; extract.ts eliminated 1 minor AST FP since the earlier snapshot (AST FP 9 -> 7), while Recall (38/57 = 66.7%), all E1-E7 counts, and Organic TPs (14) match 100%.

part1_architectural_component_ablation.description: Orthogonal component ablations of Heurion Deep Review across all 19 full-text PMC clinical & translational papers (38 clean/injected manuscripts, 57 injected errors).

part2_orthogonal_2x2_evolution_disentang.description: 2×2 factorial disentanglement of Track A (100% blind comment-driven boundary rules, ZERO ground-truth oracle) vs. Dev Audit Checklists (distilled generic zero-digit additive checklists from missed dev categories), trained sequentially on dev (N=11, 33 errors) and evaluated strictly frozen on unseen test (N=8, 24 errors). Compares default Candidate-Scoped Selective Stage-4 Routing (`cells`) against legacy Unfiltered Global Prompt Stuffing (`legacy_unfiltered_global_cells`).

frozen_track_a_rules: [domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:crude_vs_adjusted_model_boundary:cat=method_result_mismatch:kw=anova,f-test,statistical,test,reporting] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文方法学部分或表头/表注已明确声明所用统计检验类型（如方差分析及其对应统计量），且正文仅报告显著性水平而未重复列出检验统计量时，方可豁免检验统计量呈现方式不一致的质疑；若同一分析集与同一指标的前后检验类型或统计量存在实质矛盾，或未声明检验方法，则仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:dual_distribution_summary_boundary:cat=method_result_mismatch:kw=distribution,normality,median,interquartile,parametric] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文方法学章节或表头/表注已明确声明连续变量按分布分别采用参数与非参数两套汇总与检验体系，且结果部分各指标所用汇总方式与对应检验同其分布声明一致时，方可将同一表内并存的中位数/四分位数与均值/标准差视为预先声明的双分布报告边界而豁免；若同一分析集与同一指标前后矛盾或未声明分布依据，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:subcohort_denominator_stratification_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=subcohort,denominator,stratification,unclassifiable,table] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文表头或表注明确声明分析集分层、亚组分母切换或不可分类病例仅计入合计列而未纳入亚组比较时，方可豁免合计列与分列频数之和的表面不一致；若同一分析集与同一指标前后矛盾或缺乏上述声明证据，仍须报错。

frozen_audit_checklists: [domain:manuscript] [skill:review_audit:cross_section_sample_size_consistency] 审稿重点核查清单：比对摘要、方法、结果与表格表头中的总样本量及分组人数是否一致
[domain:manuscript] [skill:review_audit:estimate_interval_containment_check] 审稿重点核查清单：核对各效应量点估计是否落在其报告区间内且区间上下界顺序正确
[domain:manuscript] [skill:review_audit:abstract_conclusion_overclaim_audit] 审稿重点核查清单：比对结果统计显著性与摘要结论及讨论表述，核查夸大或因果断言。

frozen_track_a_rules: [domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:dual_distribution_summary_boundary:cat=method_result_mismatch:kw=median,interquartile,range,distributional,summary] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文方法章节以示例性措辞声明连续变量统一采用中位数与四分位距等分布汇总口径、且表头或表注未承诺逐一列出全部示例变量时，方可豁免因基线特征表按临床相关性选择性呈现部分变量而产生的所谓方法-结果不一致；若同一分析集与同一指标在方法及结果间存在前后矛盾，或属算术、区间越界、加总及未声明检验混用，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:crude_vs_adjusted_model_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=odds,ratio,log,scale,confidence] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文表头或表注明确声明该估计值来自单因素与多因素分层模型、且摘要与正文分别引用不同分析集或不同调整层级时，方可豁免点估计与置信区间不对称的质疑；若同一分析集与同一指标在摘要与表格间出现数值前后矛盾，仍须按抄录或计算错误报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:composite_reference_vs_any_test_positive_boundar:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=composite,reference,standard,any-test,positive] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文或表头/表注明确区分“任一检测阳性并集”的描述性检出计数与预设复合参考标准判定阳性计数、并给出各自定义或分析集分层证据时，方可将二者数值差异视为合法设计边界而非内部矛盾；若同一分析集、同一指标定义下前后数值仍不一致，则须照常报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:subcohort_denominator_stratification_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=subcohort,denominator,stratification,grouping] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文表头、表注或方法学段落明确声明该指标按不同分析集分层、采用亚组分母或存在未纳入当前二分组的第三分类时，方可豁免合计列与分列之和的表面差异；若同一分析集与同一指标在文内前后矛盾，仍须报错。

scrubbed_frozen_track_a_rules: [domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:crude_vs_adjusted_model_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=age-standardized,weighted,prevalence,adjusted,prevalence] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文或表头/表注明确区分描述性加权/标化患病率与多变量调整效应量（如患病率比）的分析口径，并声明前者差异表述不依赖后者模型检验时，方可豁免二者方向或显著性表述不一致的质疑；若同一分析集与同一指标的前后数值或显著性结论直接矛盾，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:dual_distribution_summary_boundary:cat=method_result_mismatch:kw=distribution,median,interquartile,mean,standard] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当统计方法章节或表头/表注已明确声明连续变量按分布分别采用均值±标准差或中位数（四分位数间距）双体系呈现并对应参数或非参数检验时，方可豁免对同一表内不同连续变量采用不同分布摘要的质疑；若原文未作此双分布声明，或同一分析集与同一指标的前后数值或检验方法自相矛盾，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:subcohort_denominator_stratification_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=denominator,stratification,missing,subgroup,covariate] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文表头或表注已声明分析集分层、亚组分母切换或缺失值排除惯例，且合计列与分列分别对应不同分母定义时，方可豁免分列之和与合计列不一致的报错；若同一分析集与同一指标前后矛盾，仍须报错。

scrubbed_frozen_track_a_rules: [domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:crude_vs_adjusted_model_boundary:cat=spin_or_guideline:kw=age-standardized,weighted,prevalence,adjusted,prevalence] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文或表头/表注明确区分年龄标化加权患病率描述与多因素校正效应估计两种分析口径，并声明前者为标化率层面比较、后者为协变量校正后关联时，方可将标化率差异表述为显著而不与校正模型结果矛盾；同一分析集与同一指标的前后矛盾仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:dual_distribution_summary_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=primary,outcome,secondary,threshold,multiple] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文或表头/表注明确区分主要结局与次要阈值分析（或不同结局口径）并分别报告各自分析结果时，方可豁免将主要结局的显著关联概括表述为总体结论、而不因次要阈值分析不显著或方向不同判定为前后矛盾；若同一分析集与同一指标在正文与表格间出现前后矛盾，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:rounding_and_percentage_convention_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=rounding,decimal,precision,reproducibility,reporting] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文或表注明确存在末位小数四舍五入或行列百分比惯例证据、且同一分析集同一指标的效应量与区间一致时，方可豁免摘要与正文间末位小数级差异；若同一分析集与同一指标出现方向性、量级或显著性结论矛盾，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:subcohort_denominator_stratification_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=missing,data,denominator,subgroup,table] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当表注或原文明确声明各列采用不同分析集或可用病例分母（如存在缺失值、亚组分层或数据可得性差异）时，合计列与亚组列频数不可加总方属合法报告边界；若同一分析集与同一指标前后矛盾，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:domain_abbreviation_homonym_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=terminology,abbreviation,synonymy,labeling] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文表头或表注已给出亚型术语的缩写、同义命名或中英文对应证据，且正文与表格的例数、分母及百分比完全一致时，方可豁免术语表述差异；若同一分析集与同一指标出现前后矛盾，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:dual_outcome_definition_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=outcome,definition,endpoint,specification,association] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文或表头/表注明确区分不同结局定义并分别报告对应效应量时，方可豁免‘同一比较口径下结论与数值矛盾’的指摘；若同一分析集与同一指标的前后表述仍不一致，则须报错。

part3_five_fold_stratified_cv_and_learni.description: 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation across all 19 papers (every paper evaluated strictly Out-of-Fold on a frozen store built solely from the ~15 training papers in its fold, yielding N=19 unseen papers and 57 unseen test errors), comparing Candidate-Scoped Selective Stage-4 Routing (`oof_selective_*`) head-to-head against Unfiltered Global Prompt Stuffing (`oof_unfiltered_global_*`), plus 5-order random permutation learning curves and qualitative failure-mode catalog.

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:dual_distribution_summary_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=complementary,reporting,sex,distribution,table] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文或表头/表注明确声明该单元格按互补类别（如另一性别或相反方向）列示百分比，且正文表述与表内数值经互补换算后一致时，方可豁免此类方向性差异；若同一分析集与同一指标的前后数值仍存在实质矛盾，则须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:domain_abbreviation_homonym_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=response,category,grouping,definition,narrative] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文正文概括性表述与表头或表注存在同一缓解/分类维度的分组口径差异证据（如合并类别未逐项列全、缩写同义或标签简写）且各组例数与百分比自洽时，方可判定为表述口径差异而非内部矛盾；若同一分析集与同一指标前后数值或定义直接冲突，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:crude_vs_adjusted_model_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=group,labeling,table,reading,directionality] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文表头或表注明确标注组别归属、且正文方向性表述与表格数值按该归属解读一致时，方可豁免组间方向性不一致的质疑；若同一分析集与同一指标在正文与表格间存在无法由组别标注解释的前后矛盾，仍须报错。

[domain:manuscript] [narrow:review_boundary:rct_itt_completer_boundary:cat=internal_inconsistency:kw=attrition,power,randomization,per-protocol] 审稿核查边界收窄：仅当原文方法学或表头/表注明确区分目标招募数（含脱落率上调）与估算所需有效样本量、并声明实际随机与脱落/不依从流程时，方可豁免目标样本与实际分析集样本的差异；若同一分析集与同一指标前后矛盾仍须报错。
frozen_audit_checklists: [domain:manuscript] [skill:review_audit:cross_section_numeric_consistency] 审稿重点核查清单：逐项比对摘要、正文与图表中同一结局的效应量、百分比及检测列表是否一致
[domain:manuscript] [skill:review_audit:method_result_consistency_audit] 审稿重点核查清单：逐项比对方法章节声明的指标与检验同结果及表格实际所用是否一致
[domain:manuscript] [skill:review_audit:abstract_conclusion_overclaim_consistenc] 审稿重点核查清单：比对结果统计显著性与摘要结论及讨论表述是否一致，核查有无夸大或强因果断言。
[domain:manuscript] [skill:review_audit:subgroup_total_arithmetic_consistency] 审稿重点核查清单：核对各亚组例数之和是否等于合计列或正文声明总数

missed_items.description: 讨论中将“VMS困扰程度与卒中严重程度无显著关联”改为“显著相关”，而表4中HFRS与NIHSS的相关p = 0.292（校正后0.364），属对阴性结果的夸大。
missed_items.find_excerpt: whereas the bothersomeness of VMS was not significantly associated with stroke severity
missed_items.replace_excerpt: and greater bothersomeness of VMS was significantly associated with more severe stroke
missed_items.why_missed: Neither deterministic AST (E6) nor section-chunked Stage 3 LLM surfaced the exact altered token(s) [and, greater, more, severe] with verbatim counterpart evidence (讨论中将“VMS困扰程度与卒中严重程度无显著关联”改为“显著相关”，而表4中HFRS与NIHSS的相关p = 0.292（校正后0.364），属对阴性结果的夸大。). Although an adjacent finding in the manuscript mentioned a related token, it targeted a different locus/organic issue without anchoring the injected sentence.

missed_items.description: 动物分组由每组n=10改为n=12，5组共60只，与方法中“Fifty male Swiss albino mice”（50只）不符。
missed_items.find_excerpt: mice were randomly divided into five groups (n = 10 each)
missed_items.replace_excerpt: mice were randomly divided into five groups (n = 12 each)
missed_items.why_missed: Deterministic AST (E1) lacks a specialized rule for this prose formulation (动物分组由每组n=10改为n=12，5组共60只，与方法中“Fifty male Swiss albino mice”（50只）不符。), and cold-start Stage 3 LLM overlooked the cross-reference among competing numerical details in the section; however, injecting zero-digit additive Audit Checklists recovered detection by explicitly directing cross-section/table verification.

missed_items.description: 摘要中安慰剂组18个月无进展比例由原文26.7%改为36.7%，与结果部分“eight patients (26.7%)”不一致。
missed_items.find_excerpt: with 70% of patients remaining progression-free compared with 26.7% in the placebo group (p = 0.001)
missed_items.replace_excerpt: with 70% of patients remaining progression-free compared with 36.7% in the placebo group (p = 0.001)
missed_items.why_missed: Deterministic AST (E3) did not match this prose pattern (摘要中安慰剂组18个月无进展比例由原文26.7%改为36.7%，与结果部分“eight patients (26.7%)”不一致。). Stage 3 section-level LLM review generated a valid dual-quoted candidate (detected when Stage 4 Verifier is ablated), but Stage 4 Full-Text Verifier conservatively classified the candidate as 'rejected' during full-manuscript reconciliation.
